components.name: Primary Green Button
components.description: Kid-side primary CTA. Stamps down on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-green { background: var(--color-green); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-display), Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; border: 3px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 18px; padding: 15px 18px; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--color-green-dk); transition: transform 80ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), box-shadow 80ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-green:hover { background: var(--color-green); } .ds-btn-green:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-green:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-green-dk); } .ds-btn-green:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Primary Purple Button
components.description: Parent-side primary CTA. Same stamp grammar at a smaller depth.
components.css: .ds-btn-purple { background: var(--color-purple); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-display), Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; border: 2.5px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 14px; padding: 11px 18px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--color-purple-dk); transition: transform 80ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), box-shadow 80ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-purple:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-purple:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-purple-dk); } .ds-btn-purple:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. No stamp; inverts on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-display), Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 14px; padding: 11px 18px; transition: background 80ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The default page container. Cream-card on cream, chunky ink border, ambient lift.
components.html:
Today's tasks
3 of 5 done. Keep it up.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-cream-card); color: var(--color-ink); border: 3px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -14px rgba(28, 27, 23, 0.30); } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-display), Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.3; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: var(--font-body), Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Chat Input
components.description: Pill-radius text input paired with a green send circle. Used in AI coach modal.
components.css: .ds-input-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; } .ds-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-body), Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13.5px; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 999px; padding: 11px 16px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-purple); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; } .ds-input-send { flex-shrink: 0; width: 42px; height: 42px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--color-green); color: #fff; border: 2.5px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-input-send:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-input-send:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Streak Badge
components.description: The 🔥 12 streak pill in the kid app top bar. The only badge that gets a stamp shadow.
components.css: .ds-badge-streak { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: var(--color-coin); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-display), Fredoka, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; border: 2.5px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 14px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--color-coin-dk); }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Settings toggle. Track color and thumb position both change so color is not the sole signal.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; } .ds-toggle-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } .ds-toggle-track { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 48px; height: 28px; border: 2.5px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); } .ds-toggle-input:checked ~ .ds-toggle-track { background: var(--color-green); } .ds-toggle-thumb { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-ink); transition: left 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), background 150ms; } .ds-toggle-input:checked ~ .ds-toggle-track .ds-toggle-thumb { left: 22px; background: #fff; } .ds-toggle-input:focus-visible ~ .ds-toggle-track { outline: 3px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-toggle-label { font-family: var(--font-body), Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Goal progress. Lav-pale track, coin fill. Always paired with percent + count meta lines.
components.css: .ds-progress { width: 100%; height: 16px; background: var(--color-lav-pale); border: 2.5px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--color-coin); border-radius: 999px; transition: width 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }

narrative.overview:
Warmth carries the joy. The interface presses down when you tap it, stays flat when you read it, and never glows or shouts to get attention. Earnie is a picture-book and a ledger at the same time: kids see a game with a chunky coin pip, a customizable mascot, and tasks that "stamp" themselves done; parents see a clear record of what was earned, what's owed, and what's been approved. Both views run on the same cream paper, the same ink linework, the same hand-feel borders. They are two rooms in one house, not two brands.

The system explicitly rejects the category defaults for both audiences. The kid app refuses generic-kid-cartoonish (gradient slime, Comic Sans, neon rainbows, drop-shadow text) and toy-store-loud (oversaturated reds, exclamation-mark copy, BUY-NOW energy). The parent app refuses cold-fintech (navy-and-gold, charts-first, adult-banking aesthetic) and sterile-SaaS (gray-on-gray, all-data-no-personality). Joy is carried by warmth — cream paper, rounded Fredoka, the coin yellow — not by volume.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper body, ink linework borders, one warm green for kid action and one warm purple for parent action
Chunky 2.5–3px ink borders on every interactive surface (buttons, cards, badges, inputs)
A two-layer elevation language: soft ambient drop-shadow for resting cards, hard bottom-only "stamp" shadow for primary CTAs
Fredoka + Nunito only; no decorative or "fun" display fonts
Coin yellow (#F4D34E) is reserved for true money signal — balance, progress, streak. Never decorative.

rules.name: The Coin-Yellow Rarity Rule
rules.body: #F4D34E is reserved for money signal (coin pip, balance bar, progress fill, streak badge, celebration). It never appears as a decoration, a background tint on a non-money card, or a highlight on a text run. Its rarity is what makes earning a coin feel like something.

rules.name: The Cream-Paper-First Rule
rules.body: Every screen background is #FBF8EF. Cards are #FCFAF3. We do not introduce a third surface color (no gradient bands, no full-bleed accent strips behind sections). Depth is carried by borders and shadows, not by surface color.

rules.name: The Two-Hue Authority Rule
rules.body: Green owns kid action. Purple owns parent action. Neither hue appears as decoration in the other shell. A green button in the parent dashboard is a bug, not a flourish.

rules.name: The Fredoka-for-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Fredoka where the system speaks (CTAs, task names, balance numerals, mascot dialogue). Use Nunito where the system records (body copy, settings, descriptions, timestamps). The two registers of the brand — game and ledger — map directly onto the two type roles.

rules.name: The 13px Floor Rule
rules.body: The smallest interactive text in the system is 13px Nunito 800. We never ship UI text below this floor. Kids are reading; parents are skimming on phones; the floor protects both.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: Ambient shadows describe where a surface rests (slightly above the page). Stamp shadows describe how a control responds to a press (bottom-only, solid, in the control's own darker shade). We never mix them on one element. Cards do not stamp; buttons do not float.

rules.name: The Flat-Reading-Surface Rule
rules.body: Body text, lists, and read-only data live on flat surfaces inside cards. We do not nest a stamp-shadowed element inside a stamp-shadowed element (never two press shadows in one tap target). Nested cards are forbidden by default.

rules.name: The Press-Confirms-Action Rule
rules.body: Every primary CTA in the system must have a stamp shadow + active translateY pair. The visual confirmation that "you pressed something" is non-negotiable on a kid-facing app. Ghost buttons are the only exception (they invert with a background tint on active).

dos: Do keep #F4D34E reserved for money signal — coin pip, balance, progress, streak, celebration. The Coin-Yellow Rarity Rule is non-negotiable.
Do put a 2.5–3px solid ink border on every interactive surface. The ink linework is the brand.
Do pair every primary CTA with a bottom-only stamp shadow in the control's own darker shade (green + green-dk, purple + purple-dk, coin + coin-dk).
Do use Fredoka for voice (CTAs, task names, balance, mascot) and Nunito for record (body, settings, descriptions, timestamps). The Fredoka-for-Voice Rule.
Do keep cards on cream-card and pages on cream. Two surface colors, not three.
Do verify text on cream hits ≥4.5:1 — ink and ink-soft are both safe; lighter grays are not.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce on the celebration overlay, modal entrance, view transitions, and toast slides — crossfade or instant only.
Do add a check glyph + strikethrough to completed tasks, not just a tint change. The Color-Is-Not-The-Only-Signal rule (from PRODUCT.md).
Do keep tap targets ≥44px on the kid app. Most existing components are already 52px+.
donts: Don't introduce a gradient anywhere. No gradient text, no gradient backgrounds, no gradient borders. This system is paper, ink, and flat color.
Don't use Comic Sans, hand-drawn-imitation display fonts, or any third type family. Fredoka and Nunito only.
Don't ship neon, oversaturated reds, or "BUY NOW" / exclamation-mark copy. Toy-store-loud is a banned aesthetic.
Don't stack stamp shadows. One press shadow per tap target. Nested cards are forbidden by default.
Don't use cream-card on a page background or cream on a card. The two-surface system is the rhythm.
Don't put the coin yellow behind non-money content. It is not a generic highlight color.
Don't introduce a third CTA hue. Green owns kid action; purple owns parent action; nothing else gets that authority.
Don't glassmorph anything. The modal's backdrop-blur-sm is functional focus, not decoration; do not extend the pattern.
Don't drop the ink border to ≤1px for "elegance". The chunky border is the brand; thinning it is exactly the cold-fintech move the brand rejects.
Don't use display fonts (Fredoka) for body copy or settings descriptions. That's the generic-kid-cartoonish trap; respect the kid by reading-friendly Nunito for record-keeping text.
Don't add a side-stripe border (border-left > 1px as a colored accent). Use a full ink border, a background tint, or a leading icon.
